user.title: Add a BE3 gateway
user.description: Choose a gateway found on the network.

data_description.port: The port this Home Assistant listens on for the gateway to connect back to.

error.cannot_connect: No BE3 gateway answered at that address.

abort.already_configured: This gateway is already set up.

identify.name: Identify component
identify.description: Makes a component flash so it can be located.

set_address.name: Change component address
set_address.description: Moves a component to a different CoTP address. Refused if the target address is already in use. If two components share an address, both will receive this command and both will move, keeping the conflict: disconnect one of them before re-addressing the other.

new_address.name: New address
new_address.description: The address to move it to.

configure_keypad.name: Configure keypad
configure_keypad.description: Provisions a component as a keypad. This overwrites the component's existing configuration, including one written by another control system.

slot.name: Device slot
slot.description: Logical slot on the gateway, 1 to 4.

buttons.name: Buttons
buttons.description: How many buttons the panel has.

name.name: Name
name.description: Label stored on the panel. Truncated to ten bytes.

slot.name: Device slot
slot.description: Logical slot on the gateway, 1 to 4.

start_update.name: Start firmware update
start_update.description: Starts a pending gateway firmware update. Only available while the gateway reports one waiting.

user.title: Add a component
user.description: Components normally appear on their own from the gateway. Add one by hand only if it is not reporting yet.

data_description.kind: What this component is. The gateway reports that an address exists but never what lives there — press Identify to make it flash if you are not sure.
data_description.buttons: Keypads only. How many buttons the panel has.
data_description.slot: Logical slot on the gateway, 1 to 4. Only used when provisioning.
data_description.panel: Components of one physical panel that share this label are grouped together. A SUBLIME Pro uses two addresses.

reconfigure.title: Component settings
reconfigure.description: Tell Home Assistant what this component is. Use the Identify button on this device if you need to find it first.

data_description.kind: What this component is. The gateway reports that an address exists but never what lives there — press Identify to make it flash if you are not sure.
data_description.buttons: Keypads only. How many buttons the panel has.
data_description.slot: Logical slot on the gateway, 1 to 4. Only used when provisioning.
data_description.panel: Components of one physical panel that share this label are grouped together. A SUBLIME Pro uses two addresses.

error.invalid_component: Those settings are not usable. A keypad needs between 1 and 6 buttons.
error.slot_in_use: Device slot already used by {slot_owner}. Two components in one slot overwrite each other's configuration on the panel.
